reels.caption: After the devastation of the Spanish Civil War, when parts of the original plans and models of Sagrada Família were destroyed, many believed the dream was over. But the vision of Antoni Gaudí refused to fade. Funded entirely by private donations, generations of supporters kept the construction alive — rebuilding models, studying Gaudí's geometry, and combining craftsmanship with modern technology. Today, the completed Sagrada Família stands not just as a church, but as a symbol of resilience, faith, and collective dedication — a masterpiece finished by the will of the people. #SagradaFamilia #GaudiLegacy #Barcelona #SpanishCivilWarHistory #ArchitecturalTriumph #BuiltByDonations #HistoricResilience #IconicLandmark #SacredArt #TimelessMasterpiece

reels.caption:
"Pluviophile: a person who enjoys rain and rainy days, and who is fascinated by the sights, sounds, etc., of rain." 🌧️

Sunny weather is okay, but there's just something about rainy days that fills my soul. 🌧️ Even overcast/gloomy days make me happier than sunny ones! It's like everything has a filter to make things softer—there's less bright light, constant white noise, and even the smell is amazing…it all helps you to slow down and enjoy the little things. 🥰

Thankful to have found so many others who love the rain like I do here! 🥲🌧️ Anyone have some really good storms recently?!

#pluviophile #rainydays☔️ #rainyweather #rainymood #cozyliving cozy home, cozy home shots, rainy day vibes, rainy aesthetic, gloomy weather, moody weather, spring aesthetic, summer mood
